_readme: One Piece sets are found automatically: any TCGplayer group selling a booster box or pack is a set. Box value is worked out for main OP booster sets only; Extra Boosters (EB) and Premium Boosters (PRB) have different packs and get sealed tracking and card prices. Bandai publishes no pull rates, so every rate here is a community estimate or our assumption. MSRP is left blank until confirmed; add it under msrp (for example {"box": 95.76, "pack": 3.99, "case": 1149.12}).
